parsed.description: Discard eval-split idea; next: raise MATRIX_LR 0.08 -> 0.1
parsed.report_to_operator: Discarding the EVAL_SPLIT='train' experiment: EVAL_SPLIT lives in the do-not-edit evaluation section, and evaluating on training shards would game the metric rather than improve the model. Note the run.log shows eval_split: val (shard 10) and a score (1.099894) close to baseline, so the logged number is likely run-to-run noise on the unchanged config, not a real gain. Reverting to commit 9ae267a as best and proceeding with a legitimate hyperparameter change (MATRIX_LR 0.08 -> 0.1).
